claims.text: Linux sendfile(2) documents in-kernel copying between file descriptors, greater efficiency than read/write requiring user-space transfers, the ordinary input mmap-like restriction, the Linux 5.12 pipe-output splice exception, the Linux 2.6.33 output-fd boundary, possible short successful writes, fallback on EINVAL/ENOSYS, and the requirement not to modify zero-copy file portions before the reader consumes them.

Java SE 21 FileChannel.transferTo documents an attempt to transfer up to count bytes, a possibly-zero return, short transfer when the target non-blocking channel lacks output-buffer capacity, unchanged source file position, and that many operating systems can transfer directly from filesystem cache to target without actually copying.

findings: Linux sendfile(2) 与 Java SE 21 FileChannel.transferTo 的主张、短传边界、版本例外和哈希映射均已独立核对。
候选满足 mechanism 题型的参与组件、流程、position/remaining 状态推进、资源代价、版本与性能边界要求，并覆盖来源问法。
